faq.title: Do you have any general questions?
faq.subtitle: If you have any general questions and want to talk to our team of specialists, contact us at: contato@igxiasolutions.com

questions.q: Do I need to know how to program or have a technical team to use the automations?
questions.a: No. Our solutions come with simple, ready-to-use instructions, even if you have never programmed or used technical tools before. Your team learns everything in minutes.

questions.q: What exactly can IGX IA automate in my business?
questions.a: We automate tasks that take time and block growth, such as prospecting, customer service, follow-ups, and lead qualification. This way, your team sells more with less effort.

questions.q: What if the automation stops working?
questions.a: If something goes wrong, our system detects and alerts us automatically. As soon as we identify the problem, our team acts to fix it as quickly as possible — before it affects your sales or operations.

questions.q: How long does it take to get my system ready?
questions.a: On average, we deliver the system working within 12 days from planning to final tests. This timeframe depends on your project's complexity, but we always keep you informed at every stage.

questions.q: How do we communicate during the project?
questions.a: We keep in touch with you via WhatsApp, directly and practically. You know what's happening at every stage.
You have a 30-day guarantee after final delivery. If you are not satisfied with the results, we refund 100% of your investment.

questions.q: How do you create the solutions?
questions.a: We plan based on your goals and integrate via robust platforms like Make, N8N, and Flowise. Everything is customized for your business, with a professional standard.
